title: Consume the #4929 center-free word with coded reverse stages and A⁻¹-mixed query shears (no κ)
body:
## Change and scope

A consumer for the #4929 center-free coded word, answering the caller question that #4933 leaves open (negative-query banks stay coded). Instead of decoding the reverse stages, conjugate the controller: every reverse stage is the center-free backward word (coupling −A·Q); every forward stage is a query-only shear whose source is first mixed by A⁻¹ = I + (A−I)/13. Then `Coded = (A on x-roles) · Standard · (A⁻¹ on x-roles)`, so only the controller-boundary x-roles and the thin-stage sources are recoded. **No κ is promoted; the physical adapter and the 1/13 scalar are not claimed.**

## Evidence (`research/coded-reverse-controller/verify.py`, ~3 min, stdlib, Python 3.12)

- A = I − RᵀR/4 for the joint-query packet; (A−I)(A+13I)=0; A⁻¹ = I+(A−I)/13.
- Exact diagonalization of the coded controller equals the standard controller for p = 3, 4, 5, 8; only new boundary denominator is 13. Three negative controls fail (uncoded forward stages, coded thick forward ends, wrong inverse).
- Exact 448×448 conjugation identity at p=2 with the real 112×112 A.
- Invoice model reproduces the published 0.0030201659770; raw complex roots 0.00793 (p=8), 0.00758 (p=19) (cf. ~0.00765 in #4933). p=19 strict tail guards pass at C=0.0034 (α .99579, γ .9638, δ .9516).
- Repo outer ledger (54 strict + 4 functional predicates) accepts every κ up to 0.0033999971; at 0.0034 only `actual_bit_above_effective` fails. So if the recodings are admissible, the BIT supplier caps the conditional κ at about 0.0034 (+12.5% over 0.0030217758).
- `research_package.py` registered replay, metadata/pins and `check_research_commit.py --check-source-history` pass locally. No hosted CI, Lean or independent review yet.

## Not established

1. Physical admission of the thin-stage A⁻¹ mixing and the x-role input/output conversions at the actual frames (#4933's monomial normalizers; #4932 bounds only a standalone one-bank adapter, not these maps).
2. Pricing of ×1/13 (fixed-denominator; cf. #4630).
3. Compiler constants for ambient rank 153 (published tensor power 1024 violates the capacity inequality near 0.0034) and the integer-height test.

## Overlap

#4933 / Discussion #4930 (caller with coded negative banks), #4932 (one-bank adapter ceiling). Overlap helper reported only unrelated QQ16 packages. Scientific inputs frozen at canonical `cef4b52f2` (no new commits at submission). Open next questions are in `TASK.json` and the README.

## Credit

Dugongue (#4929); Cinna Davis/1337isnot1337 (#4694, #4470 controller, #4440 thinning); Cao Yifan (#4610); zxv and all retained lineage. The controller engine (`complex_controller_factor.py`) and ledger are theirs; the delta is the stage assignment, its exact diagonalization and the arithmetic. Derivation and package by Claude (Anthropic) under Cayden Burkart's direction; no independent human or kernel review.
